svg.title: Nanophotonics for practical optical computing
svg.desc: A 4:3 adaptation of the author-provided early conceptual figure. Fabrication, devices and materials enable optical computing functions and applications. A raster artwork layer preserves the soft illustrative finish; all 29 labels are separate vector elements. Applications shown are autonomous driving, embodied intelligence and optical communication. The graphic is a conceptual overview, not performance data.
